patch_list: Replaces the loading screen shown when a video starts with your own video. WebM (VP9 or AV1) or MP4 (H.265/HEVC).
Removes ads (splash, banners, popups, interstitials and native ads).
Recolors the app's accent (selected tabs, buttons, highlights, progress) from the stock orange to a purple gradient. Does not change the layout of any screen.
